label: sequence began with i (pos 0 or 1): fires through rest of input and at <DEL>
explanation: Fires on original-phase steps and the <DEL> step of sequences whose first (or second) original token is i. It switches on from t=2 (orig(0)=i) or t=3 (orig(1)=i) and stays on until <DEL>, then stops almost entirely in the copy phase (just a weak echo at the first copy steps). Activation is strongest when orig(0)=i, especially for i i ... openings (top examples reach ~1.0 of max), and weaker when i is at position 1 (~0.2-0.5). It does not fire at t=0-1, almost never fires during copy (1.8% of mass), and is not driven by the current input token. Misses are mainly weak (lowest-quartile) background activations in sequences with no early i, plus a few cases with i at position 2. False positives are mostly orig(1)=i sequences where it stays silent. Dev F1 0.68, mass recall 0.82.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=i (+14.33), orig0=i (+9.57), t=2 & prev_tok=e (+9.32), t=2 & prev_tok=k (+7.21), next_out=i (+6.79), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+5.75). Lower it: phase=2 (-19.65), prev2_tok=- (-9.76), out_tok=e (-6.82), out_tok=z (-6.28).
